assessment.nobel_worthiness: A highly distinctive voice. The fiction builds dream-logic worlds in which ordinary psychology, space and causality are deliberately dismantled, and this is carried by sentence-level and structural invention rather than by theme alone. The listed works, Frontier and Love in the New Millennium, sit within a long, formally consistent body of novels and stories. The achievement looks idealistic in the will's sense: an uncompromising literary project with real imaginative depth.
assessment.attribution: A single novelist and short-story writer writing in Chinese. A citation would focus on radical narrative invention and the reimagining of the fantastic and the inward in modern Chinese fiction. Credit is unambiguous.
assessment.maturity: A decades-long, consistently pursued oeuvre, with sustained quality asserted by public reputation. Timing is suitable. The method is stable and mature rather than a late shift.
uncertainties: Only part of the large Chinese-language output is available in English, so the corpus is incompletely assessed.
Translation quality shapes how the prose style reads, and I have not independently verified any text.
The risk that the formal monotony of the method outweighs its range over the whole oeuvre cannot be settled from the supplied description.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Meditative, morally serious prose with a recognizable cadence. Housekeeping and the Gilead novels join theology, family and American history through quiet formal control. Her interiority and her handling of grace, memory and ordinary life give her imaginative and intellectual depth. The fiction is compact, and the essays extend the same intellectual project.
assessment.attribution: A single writer of fiction and essays in English. A citation would address moral and spiritual interiority rendered in luminous prose. Credit is clear.
assessment.maturity: A small number of novels over several decades, with high sustained quality and a coherent vision. The oeuvre is durable, though narrower in volume and range than some other candidates.
uncertainties: The fiction is thematically narrow, so it is unclear how far the achievement extends beyond a single, deeply explored world.
The weight of the essays relative to the novels is hard to judge from the listing.
Public acclaim in English should not stand in for a judgement of formal achievement.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Visionary, densely patterned prose that turns memory, the body and dream into an expansive metaphysical project. Blinding and Solenoid show ambition of scale combined with a strongly individual voice and a deep inheritance from Romanian and European literary tradition. The imaginative reach is large, and he also works in poetry.
assessment.attribution: A single writer of fiction and poetry in Romanian. A citation would address encyclopedic, visionary prose and the poetics of the inward cosmos. Credit is unambiguous.
assessment.maturity: A substantial, internally connected body of work with an established late-career phase. The question is whether the major novels' scale and excess are sustained as quality across the whole oeuvre.
uncertainties: The poetry, which is central to his formation, is thinly translated, as are parts of the prose, so coverage is uneven.
English and other translations of the long novels carry considerable uncertainty about the fidelity of style.
The claim of sustained quality rests on public reception, not on my own reading.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large, polyphonic novels that remake the form through Indigenous sovereignty, oral structures and ecological time. Carpentaria and The Swan Book show linguistic and structural invention that is not reducible to subject matter, and the work widens what the English-language novel can hold. The scale of imagination is considerable.
assessment.attribution: A single writer of fiction and nonfiction in English. A citation would address narrative form drawn from Aboriginal storytelling and landscape, and the epic reach of the novels. Credit is clear.
assessment.maturity: A smaller number of very large books across roughly three decades, with an established standing. The oeuvre is still developing, so judgements of overall durability are more provisional than for longer careers.
uncertainties: The relatively small number of major works makes the assessment of sustained quality less certain.
Political and cultural significance must not stand in for literary merit, and I cannot separate them from the listing alone.
I have not independently verified any text or the density of the prose.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Hybrid works that remake the boundaries between classical scholarship, lyric, narrative and visual form. Autobiography of Red and Nox are inventive and intellectually deep, with a strongly recognizable voice that is dry, exact and emotionally charged. Her engagement with Greek antiquity gives the work historical depth.
assessment.attribution: A single writer of poetry, essays and drama in English, who also translates. A citation would address formal reinvention and the lyric reworking of the classical inheritance. Credit is clear, though the translations are a separate category of work.
assessment.maturity: A long career with a consistent method and strong reception. Some later books extend rather than deepen the earlier achievement.
uncertainties: The boundary between her original work and her translations and adaptations complicates how a citation is framed.
Genre hybridity makes comparison with novelists under common criteria harder.
The relation of the book-object to the text is lost in any summary, and I have not read the works.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large poetic sequences, including Purgatory and Anteparadise, turn suffering and the Chilean dictatorship into a collective, memorial poetry with an ambition that reaches landscape scale. The voice is intense and unmistakable, and the project is formally and morally serious.
assessment.attribution: A single poet writing in Spanish. A citation would address a poetry of collective memory and extreme witness. Credit is clear.
assessment.maturity: A sustained poetic career of several decades with a coherent project. The later work extends the central themes.
uncertainties: Poetry is notoriously difficult to assess in translation, and the English renderings of the long sequences are partial.
Some of the work's force lies in extra-textual acts and installations, which are hard to weigh as literature.
The political and historical significance of the subject must be kept separate from the verbal achievement.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Radical narrative structures link bodily experience to dictatorship and social exclusion. E. Luminata and The Fourth World are formally severe and sit within a distinct experimental line of Latin American writing. Her work has real intellectual depth and a voice that resists easy reading.
assessment.attribution: A single writer of fiction and essays in Spanish. A citation would address experimental prose that places the body and the margin at the centre of political experience. Credit is clear.
assessment.maturity: A long and coherent body of work from the early 1980s onward. The achievement is established, though the density of the method limits how widely it can be assessed in translation.
uncertainties: Translation coverage into English and Swedish is limited, so the corpus is incompletely assessable.
The difficulty of the prose makes it hard to judge how well it survives translation.
The relative weight of her essays and performance-adjacent work is unclear from the supplied description.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Remade Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and a sustained dialogue with inherited forms. Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and A Time Between Ashes and Roses reflect a long modernizing project in Arabic poetry, with essays that give it theoretical depth. The influence on the language of Arabic poetry is substantial.
assessment.attribution: A single poet and essayist writing in Arabic. A citation would address the renewal of Arabic poetic form and the dialogue with tradition. Credit is clear.
assessment.maturity: A very long career with an established place. Questions concern whether the later work matches the formal force of the earlier collections.
uncertainties: Poetry in Arabic is hard to judge in translation, particularly where the work engages prosody and classical forms.
The weight of his critical and theoretical writing relative to the poetry is uncertain.
Public stature and political position must not substitute for assessment of the verbal achievement.
